reason: Based on the repository and README, the plugin’s primary purpose is a user-facing conversation navigation panel for DeepSeek Harness, providing a side tick rail for locating and jumping to user messages with hover previews and keyboard/mouse controls. Its scope is UI navigation only, with no evidence of external service integration or terminal/automation capabilities.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面的导航类插件，在会话旁边显示刻度导航条，可预览与跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: This is a conversation navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows a side tick rail to browse your messages with preview and jump interactions.

capabilities: Render a conversation-side navigation rail in the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Map user messages to a tick-based index in the conversation view
Show local hover previews of selected messages
Provide click and keyboard interactions to jump/scroll to message targets
Run as a web client plugin without a separate host component

reasons.code: README describes a pure web-client plugin that mounts in `shell.overlay`, indexes conversation ticks, previews messages, and enables jump navigation.
package.json declares `dsh.client.platform` as `web` and `main` exports include only plugin entry files, indicating UI-side functionality only.
Repository structure lists only client/manifest/plugin files (e.g., client.js, index.js, patch), with no background service or system-control components.
